Hi 👋 i'm Cat Dachtler i have been an Equine Sports massage therapist and rehabilitation specialist over 20 yrs & over 30yrs as a professional handler, rider, instructor, competitor

As a Rehabilitation specialist i focused on foundation training & remedial therapy, relaxation is key when restarting or starting any horse & something many trainers miss 

I qualified as an Equine Sports Masseuse under Mary Bromiley MBE in 1995 and 1998 for sports massage therapist for people / riders.
I used to help horses all over the UK, give clinics and host workshops i’m also a qualified group fitness coach and deliver Rider Fitness 

Now owners learn to build a better relationship with their horses & get their desired out comes with me online 

my website www.back-in-the-saddle.co.uk is now closed as i rebuild from ground zero after chronic illness put me on my bum bum

You tell me why you and your horse would benefit from having a better relationship
